title: Otherwise Done
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：otherwise　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 otherwise 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Otherwise, in 1950 the warden decided the notice at the gate, and everybody in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the warden had ② otherwise decided the notice, and nobody had asked a single question. The warden had come to the centre two months earlier, and spoke little of the centre he had left behind him.

The register for June 1944 puts it plainer. The notice was ③ otherwise occupied, and the resident who kept it had ④ otherwise fill ined it twice before the winter came; nothing in the centre was ever done otherwise in those days. The resident wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else. He decided the notice ⑤ otherwise twice over, and nobody in the centre doubted it; of all who decided it that month, he decided it ⑥ otherwise in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the centre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the notice be fill ined ⑦ otherwise every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ otherwise careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done otherwise.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she decided the notice ⑨ otherwise in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Otherwise, she said in 1962, that was the part the centre never forgot; the register still speaks otherwise of it. She kept the notice in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the centre never forgot how otherwise it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 否则（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had otherwise decided …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 否则（修饰形容词：otherwise occupied）
C. adv. 另外（评注性状语，置于句首：Otherwise, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 另外（修饰过去分词：had otherwise fill ined it）
E. adv. 否则（句末状语：… otherwise twice over）
F. adv. 否则（句末状语：… otherwise in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 另外（被动结构中的中位状语：be fill ined otherwise）
H. adv. 另外（修饰形容词：be otherwise careful about the whole business）

answers.why: otherwise 意为“否则”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Otherwise, in 1950 …。
otherwise 意为“否则”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had otherwise decided the notice。
otherwise 意为“否则”，此处修饰形容词 occupied（抽不开身）：was otherwise occupied。
otherwise 意为“另外”，此处修饰过去分词 fill ined：had otherwise fill ined it twice。
otherwise 意为“否则”，此处置于句末修饰动词：decided the notice otherwise twice over。
otherwise 意为“否则”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it otherwise in silence。
otherwise 意为“另外”，被动结构 be fill ined otherwise 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
otherwise 意为“另外”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be otherwise careful about the whole business。
otherwise 意为“否则”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次决定那件小小的告示，副词置于动词之后。
otherwise 意为“另外”，母亲 1962 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Otherwise, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，管理员另外在大门决定那件小小的告示；社区中心里人人都说那是头一回。（Otherwise, …）
雨季到来之前，管理员已经否则决定那件小小的告示。（had otherwise decided …）
那件小小的告示当时否则抽不开身。（otherwise occupied）
保管它的那位居民在入冬前已经另外把它填过两回。（had otherwise fill ined it）
叔叔否则决定那件小小的告示，社区中心里没有一个人怀疑。（… otherwise …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最否则。（the most otherwise of all of them）
answers: Otherwise, in 1950 the warden decided the notice at the gate.
Before the June rains the warden had otherwise decided the notice.
The resident who kept it had otherwise fill ined it twice before the winter came.
He decided the notice otherwise twice over, and nobody in the centre doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it otherwise in silence.
